paper.title: Wave function Ansatz (but Periodic) Networks and the Homogeneous Electron Gas
paper.authors: Max Wilson, Saverio Moroni, Markus Holzmann, Nicholas Gao, Filip Wudarski, Tejs Vegge, Arghya Bhowmik

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 7 (7 up, 0 down), r_s = 1, simple cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (WAP-net (n_d=1)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Rydberg). The paper uses Rydberg units, so the printed energy and error bar are multiplied by convention_factor 0.5 to give Hartree. Madelung term: included: N_e*v_M self-image (Madelung) term explicitly added to V(X); Ewald summation. Boundary: periodic, Gamma point (psi(r+L)=psi(r); plane-wave HF orbitals at k=2pi n/L; no twist mentioned).
